"""Load configuration from files and strings."""

import os

from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
from miniconf.parser import parse_lines

_INCLUDE = "@include"


def _expand(path, stack, include_site=None):
    real = os.path.realpath(path)
    if real in stack:
        raise ConfigError("include cycle detected: {}".format(path))
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            raw_lines = fh.read().splitlines()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        if include_site is None:
            raise
        raise ConfigError("{}: include file not found: {}".format(include_site, path))
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
        if include_site is None:
            raise
        raise ConfigError("{}: cannot read include file {}: {}".format(include_site, path, exc))

    stack = stack + (real,)
    base = os.path.dirname(real)
    out = []
    for lineno, raw in enumerate(raw_lines, start=1):
        parts = raw.split(None, 1)
        if parts and parts[0] == _INCLUDE:
            target = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
            site = "{}:{}".format(path, lineno)
            if not target:
                raise ConfigError("{}: @include requires a path".format(site))
            target = os.path.join(base, target)
            out.extend(_expand(target, stack, site))
        else:
            out.append(raw)
    return out


def load(path):
    """Read and parse the configuration file at ``path``.

    ``@include <path>`` lines are replaced inline by the contents of the
    referenced file, resolved relative to the including file's directory.
    """
    return parse_lines(_expand(path, ()))


def loads(text):
    """Parse configuration from a string."""
    return parse_lines(text.splitlines())

import os,tempfile
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
c=load("examples/service.conf"); print(c.get("level",section="logging"), c.get("port",section="http"))
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.mkdir(d+"/sub")
w=lambda n,t:open(d+"/"+n,"w").write(t)
w("a.conf","x=1\n@include sub/b.conf\ny=a\n"); w("sub/b.conf","x=2\n@include c.conf\n"); w("sub/c.conf","z=3\ny=c\n")
c=load(d+"/a.conf"); print(c.get("x"),c.get("y"),c.get("z"))
w("m.conf","@include nope.conf\n")
w("s.conf","@include s.conf\n"); w("p.conf","@include q.conf\n"); w("q.conf","@include p.conf\n")
for f in "msp":
    try: load(d+"/%s.conf"%f)
    except ConfigError as e: print("ok",e)
EOF
